article.title: ‘Self-imposed irrelevance’: why the EU is failing to act on growing public criticism of Israel

instructions: Nutze scenePlan als Szenenplan. Lade pro Eintrag startImagePath als image-to-video Startbild und verwende videoPrompt als Bewegungsanweisung. durationSeconds gibt die geplante Szenenlänge an.

scenePlan.title: France’s Critical Position Illuminates the EU
scenePlan.beat: This scene depicts France’s emerging critical stance within the EU, represented by a single cubist figure holding a fractured hand lamp that emits searching, fragmented light. The surrounding space contains abstract shapes symbolizing EU political stalemate. The lamp’s light visibly cuts through the darkness, embodying hope, scrutiny, and the push for accountability regarding Israel and EU paralysis.

The motif 'The 27-member EU bloc' is visually represented by the crowded, fractured composition, emphasizing the bloc’s inability to act collectively on Israel policy.
